text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've got a scrimmage... today?<n>And at Oi
Racecourse too... There's<n>even a crowd!

text_block_list.name: People from Downtown
text_block_list.text: Hehe, Inari! Your trainer invited us, so<n>here we are!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Can't have a race without some<n>noise. As for the
race, think of it as an<n>ice-breaker. All these runners
are<n>gonna be your teammates after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A little notice woulda been nice! But<n>well, if that's
whatcha want me to do,<n>I guess I've got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Good, that's the spirit. Now... go get<n>changed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems the race Inari One's trainer<n>wanted me to
come see is a<n>scrimmage between her and her
new<n>teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Scanning my surroundings, it looks<n>like he called
together a number of<n>locals as well. Everyone from
the<n>soba shop owner to that feisty alley<n>cat is here...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And every one of them smiles<n>warmly as Inari One
leaves the gate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A scrimmage with all the other<n>newbies, huh? I get
where he's<n>comin' from, but he couldn't have<n>told
me sooner? This isn't somethin'<n>you should just
spring on someone<n>last minute. Urgh...)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, get your head outta the clouds!<n>Pretty soon
here she's gonna lose<n>steam, and then I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Urrrauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Huh?! She's... speeding up!)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
I, uh... I ended up in fifth, so I guess<n>my stamina still
needs some work...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Wheeze!GRRRAAAUUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, hey! She's... she's like a totally<n>different
runner!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Oh no, you doooon't!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! I'm not done... I'm not done<n>yeeeet!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A shock to us all, Inari One seems to<n>be losing the
battle of fighting spirit!<n>With only two hundred
meters to go,<n>at this rate, she's going to lose!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As that fear flashes through my mind,<n>my mouth
opens on its own...
choice_data_list: Inari One! You can do iiiit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: GRRRAUUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her opponent is on her tail the whole<n>way... but in
the end, Inari One wins<n>by a nose.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: AAAUGH! Darn it aaall! I lost agaaain!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... N-now wait a minute...When did you... get so strong?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
That was a close one... But, well, I<n>think ya get the
idea, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
We don't need ya stickin' around<n>outta obligation.
Even without you, my<n>team'll get the crowd goin'
just<n>fine...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Chief, what're ya talkin'about?! I'm s'posed to run on yourteam here in Oi Raceco—

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: For cryin' out loud, girl, didja think Iwouldn't notice?! I can see that youdon't wanna be here in your heart ofhearts. I'm old, not blind.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
You want to go to Tracen, right?<n>Hidin' your true
desires doesn't suit<n>you, girl.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: If you're a true Edo girl, you'll takeon the Twinkle Series, show 'emwhat the downtown's made of, andbecome a racing sensation there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ch-Chief...

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
He's right, you know! No matter<n>where you're
runnin', we'll be<n>cheerin' you on!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Show 'em how we do things<n>downtown! Turn that
Twinkle stage<n>upside down!

text_block_list.name: People from Downtown
text_block_list.text: YEEEAH! INARI! INARI! INARI! INARI!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guys...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, wipe that gloomy look off your<n>face. Go,
you've got transfer<n>paperwork to fill out!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
You've already got a trainer ready to<n>scout you...
And I think we both know<n>they had something to do
with your<n>victory today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Chief... Yeah. Yeah... you're right!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Several weeks later...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, guess who's ready to<n>rumble!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The downtown girl ready to throw<n>down! Starting
today, Edo girl Inari is<n>takin' on all of Tracen
Academy!<n>...Wazzup?
choice_data_list: Inari One! I'm so glad you're finally here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just Inari's fine. Full names are for<n>strangers, and
no way I'd take on the<n>road ahead with someone I
don't<n>trust! Got that, Boss?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's show 'em what you're made of!
Yeah! Let's show 'em what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just Inari's fine. Full names're for<n>strangers, and
no way I'd take on the<n>road ahead with someone I
don't<n>trust! Got that, Boss?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's show 'em what you're made of!
Yeah! Let's show 'em what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! This sparky Oi racer's gonna<n>set fire to the
Twinkle Series!
